climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A small California valley AVA in the Sierra Pelona Mountains of northwestern Los Angeles County, around Agua Dulce. Grapes have been grown here only since 1995, and by 2008 there were 96 acres of commercial vineyards.
